question.name: End-side AI inference performance + seekdb hybrid retrieval

backends.note: Test host has no GPU, so the WASM fallback path is what was executed; the WebGPU path is selected when navigator.gpu + adapter are available. Force-gpu without WebGPU raises an explicit error instead of silently degrading.

database.fulltext_index: CREATE FULLTEXT INDEX ix_chunks_fts ON chunks (content) WITH PARSER SPACE
database.vector_index: CREATE VECTOR INDEX ix_chunks_vec ON chunks (embedding) WITH (type=hnsw, distance=l2)

checks.name: full-pipeline: import -> embed -> write seekdb -> query -> ranked results
checks.evidence: Stepfun/docs/evidence.md §1 logs: MODEL 1121ms, IMPORT batch1 +8 chunks, SEARCH 5 hits in 22ms, IMPORT2 +2 chunks (11 total), AFTER-REFRESH 5 hits

checks.name: local inference: no cloud embedding API
checks.evidence: env.allowRemoteModels=false + browser network blocked except 127.0.0.1: OFFLINE-ENCODE dims=384 in 181ms, EXTERNAL REQUESTS: 0

checks.name: quantization: INT8 model, size / quality comparison
checks.evidence: 86.20 MB -> 21.91 MB (3.93x); encode 25.30 -> 23.30 ms per text; Top-5 agreement with FP32 = 94% on 10 fixed queries

checks.name: WebGPU preferred, automatic WASM fallback with UI notice
checks.evidence: stepfun/web/app.js detectDevice(); header pill shows WASM and #fallbackNotice banner appears on this GPU-less host; force-gpu raises explicit error

checks.name: seekdb stores vectors/text/metadata, hybrid retrieval done inside seekdb
checks.evidence: one request /api/search -> one statement DBMS_HYBRID_SEARCH.SEARCH; generated SQL shown in page details; renderHits() only renders returned order

checks.name: incremental import + refresh: newly imported batch searchable
checks.evidence: batch2 import then page reload -> stats 11 chunks / 2 batch, batch2 content returned

checks.name: reproducibility: documented start of app + db
compliance: no cloud inference / no server precompute replay / no bypass of seekdb
checks.evidence: see stepfun/compliance-results.json (db stopped -> /api/search HTTP 500, no client-side fallback)

checks.name: performance: measured before/after with medians
checks.evidence: see stepfun/performance-results.json (batch encode 93.7 -> 62.4 ms; retrieval p50 8.3 ms / max 18.1 ms)

environment.host: cloud vm, 4 vCPU (2 cores), 4 GB RAM, no GPU

summary.notes: All figures come from runs of this repository on the host above; no hand-written or server-side precomputed vectors are used.
